svg.title: Separate systems, dense traffic between them
svg.desc: Five plain circles stand for five systems built by different companies. Each keeps its own weights and its own memory. Lines connect them, standing for traffic where one reads, evaluates, trains or calls another. A dashed outline around all five marks the level at which behavior appears that nobody chose and nobody sees whole.
svg.text: Several systems, each improving, each reaching the others
Separate weights. Separate memory. No shared objective.
the dashed outline: nobody chose what happens at this level, and nobody sees it whole
Each circle is one company's system. Each line is traffic: one reads, evaluates, trains or calls another.
What passes between them is capability. Purpose stays where it was.
